core: Exact v0.1 723-example cohort and five parent-root folds; unchanged validation/prefix semantics. All endpoints use all core examples.
coverage: Only v0.1 exclusions for fewer than four completed partners may be recovered; require two completed partners and identical remaining rules. Only duration M0/M1/M2; never fabricate older donors. Inherit every old root fold; append new lexical roots and assign index modulo five.

targets.duration: ln(next whole validated focal coda ICI-sum duration / 1 second)
targets.count: validated whole next focal coda click count; no clipping/rounding of predicted means
targets.gap: ln((immediate next focal onset - current completion cutoff) / 1 second); strictly positive precision-separated; conditional on the eligible recorded occurrence

numerics.ridge: For r=Xw+b-y, every normal-equation coefficient residual sum(x_j*r)+alpha*w_j and intercept residual sum(r) must be finite. Divide abs residual by max(1,sum(abs(x_j)*(abs(pred)+abs(y)))+alpha*abs(w_j)), intercept divisor max(1,sum(abs(pred)+abs(y))). Require max normalized residual <= 64*binary64_epsilon*(n+p+1). This dimension-scaled backward-error engineering allowance covers scalar summation, centering and stable SVD arithmetic; frozen before outcomes, not an iterative solver tol.
numerics.poisson: Mean half-Poisson-deviance gradient: sum(x_j*(mu-y))/n + alpha*w_j; intercept sum(mu-y)/n. Finite objective, coefficients, raw predictions and gradient required; max abs gradient <= frozen 1e-6 exactly; no extra allowance.

metrics.ridge: mean squared natural-log error; paired gain loss(self)-loss(recent), in squared log units, not bits. Mean absolute log error diagnostic. exp(prediction) is a back-transformed log-scale point, not arithmetic expected duration/gap.
metrics.poisson: mean 2*(y*ln(y/mu)-y+mu) for positive whole counts; conditional-mean working model, not Poisson biological noise or ornamentation. Count MAE diagnostic. Record means outside each fold training count range and source valid range.
metrics.weights: pooled sample mean primary; equal-root macro secondary; all root contributions and fixed-prediction root deletions

strata.previous: previous focal history present/absent from available prefix
strata.overlap: Any of latest two completed partners definitely overlaps current focal coda under disjoint rounding envelopes: min(lower ends)>max(upper onsets)+1e-12. Other cell is no definite overlap, including rounding ambiguity; no future call.
strata.age: Latest completed partner end-age <= training-partition median versus > median. Linear median, ties in at-or-below cell. Store fold threshold and all empty/small cells; fewer than five contributing roots labeled limited, never excluded.

bootstrap.weighting: uniform parent-root draws with replacement; keep every paired row and multiplicity; identical core draw indices across three endpoints; separate coverage draws
bootstrap.interpretation: 95% pointwise conditional/descriptive; no refit uncertainty, certified independence or simultaneous/family-wise coverage

examples: First source-order held-out example per lexical root, first five roots, as v0.1; no score selection. Select core examples, all core endpoints share them.
failureRules: Any missing/invalid target or inconsistent core parity halts preparation; no silent support reduction.
Fewer than three eligible roots or empty partitions: unavailable whole endpoint.

Nonfinite fitted parameters/predictions/objective, positive-mean violation, convergence warning, iteration limit or numerical acceptance failure: whole endpoint failed with fold/model identity; no successful-fold-only aggregate.
Run all other prespecified endpoints despite a failure; no solver/threshold/seed/lag/target search or favorable selection.
Changed frozen input, uncommitted producer or saved output present: refuse new writing run. Reproduction compares without overwriting.
limitations: Exploratory reuse chosen after seeing v0.1; not independent confirmation.
Exact REC/local callers only; six-character roots are author recording associations, not certified independent encounters or global identities.
Paper overlap-duration matching differs from completed-history forecasting. Neither null nor positive forecast replicates/refutes that overlap analysis.
Target and model change together from v0.1; differences do not isolate binning. Gains have different units and are not compared by subtraction.
Gap means time until the next eligible recorded focal coda conditional on occurrence/recording, not partner reply latency, speaking probability, survival analysis or causality.
Poisson is a working conditional-mean model; count prediction is not ornament detection or a validated generative distribution.
Older control changes recency and does not remove shared context, tempo, type or selection confounds.
Coverage changes eligibility and training support together. Strata and deletion summaries are descriptive, not refitted validation or independent replications.
Pointwise group intervals omit refit uncertainty and multiplicity correction; roots are not verified independent encounters.
The archive 3840/paper 3948 correspondence and recording/session/individual crosswalk remain unresolved. No original WAV mapping or new human review.
Better forecasting does not validate generation on arbitrary synthetic codas or establish learned whale-response rules.
